title: The Final Curtain
subtitle: Everything is a mess, everything has come to an end. Perhaps ... there's still a chance.

items.text: The Final Curtain
Guest Room, St. Pavlov Foundation

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hehe! I never knew that so many people lived on the river!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I saw them tie plastic bottles to planks to make a bridge, and then they crossed the river as if they were walking on a row of puffpuff fish!
Sotheby's sheltered life has given her few chances to witness the struggles of those on the verge of hunger.
But ever since she came to consciousness on the water's edge, that same question has lingered in her heart.
She restrains herself from voicing it.
Duncan's well known in the favela, and everyone keeps telling her, "Yes, that old man is Duncan from the Veterans' Residence!" It's like she's trapped in some kind of dream.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: I know what you're thinking, little lady.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: But I am Duncan. My ID card, my military record, my medals—they all prove it.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: As for your friend, Mr. Karson, listen, I know it's hard, but at some point, we have to move on.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Thank you for the advice; it's just ...

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: Pardon me.
The Foundation staff member gently pushes open the door.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hm?

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: My apologies for interrupting.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: Ms. Sotheby, I heard about what happened in the favela. Thanks to your efforts, Zeno has been able to recruit a new group of spirited youths.
The staff member then turns to Mr. Duncan.
Sotheby gives a proud nod. She's more than just a pretty dress. She did her very best to help her friends in the favela while the others were busy with their missions.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: Mr. Duncan, we need to record your information and cross-reference it with that of Mr. Karson, who was lost during the "Storm" of 1929.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: It's bewildering, isn't it? How could there be another Mr. Karson?
A fervent era filled with ambition, dreams, and madness.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: Please come with me, Mr. Duncan. It won't take long. After that, you'll need to initiate the procedures for your re-enlistment in the Zeno Arms Academy.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: While the said procedures are underway, the rehab center will take care of the injuries you sustained in São Paulo. Welcome back to our cause.
Hallway, St. Pavlov Foundation

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: There have been many cases like yours.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: Politicians, singers, the list goes on. The Foundation compared them to photos from the '90s. While their appearances had changed, they were undoubtedly the same person.
These words leave Duncan feeling puzzled.
This place is strange, and their language is even stranger.

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: Heh, hey! Isn't that Lieutenant Lilya?
Lilya is sauntering down the hallway, swigging on her flask.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: This is an alcohol-free zone, Lieutenant Lilya. Please try to follow the regulations.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Oh, did I just wander into another dry zone? Great.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: So many rules and regulations. Ugh, how boring!

items.speaker: Mr. Duncan
items.text: Has Lopera arrived?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: She's in her room right now. Vertin managed to secure her some rest time before her interrogation. Poor girl.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Honestly, no one deserves to go through what she has.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: It's even worse than being cooped up and buried in paperwork.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: Ahem, clerical work is essential, too.
She gives an awkward smile at this mockery of her work.
Lilya cheerfully pats her on the shoulder and turns back to Duncan.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Well, good luck, Comrade Duncan. Don't forget to stretch your hand between signing papers.
She'd rather ride her Red 38 until her legs went numb than be stuck in an office all day.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: You also need to write a report, Lieutenant Lilya.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: Our executives are quite curious to know how you managed to escape the rebels' custody.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Moldir, the woman in charge of the base, had one of her guards release me.
Moldir's orders saved Lilya's life.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: You mean to say that Moldir, the lieutenant who's joined the rebellion, set you free?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I think so. At least, that's what the guard told me.

items.speaker: Prison Guard
items.text: "Lieutenant Moldir asked me to help you. Take care—"

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: I'll be sure to make note of that. And of course, please specify this in your written report as well.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: This is very important, Lieutenant.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: If she's having doubts, then we may still have a chance to win back Igor's rebels.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff Member
items.text: Or at least some of them.
Administration Office, Foundation
Vice President Constantine makes a long-overdue call with the Pax House.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Igor fooled us all with his rebellion.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: It's been confirmed that the Dr. Dores he took is none other than Ms. Urd.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The motives behind his actions, however, are still unclear.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: While only a small number of the Zeno soldiers chose to join his rebellion, I believe it is necessary to urge the Zeno Arms Academy to strengthen the discipline of their members.
She removes a white chess piece from the board in front of her.

items.speaker: President
items.text: No need to worry about that. Zeno will handle it themselves.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: If that's your judgment, then I have no objections.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: On a separate note, Moth, our mole planted within Manus Vindictae, has sent us some new information.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The Manus are sending supplies, personnel, and weapons in huge numbers to the south. It appears our suspicions were correct. Manus Vindictae is preparing a ritual to draw forth another "Storm."

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The location of Jerry Wilson provided by Ms. Lucy confirms that the Manus are moving toward Antarctica.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Additionally, it's now clear that some of the arcanist organizations, including the Apostles Brotherhood, have been assisting the Manus through criminal activities such as smuggling and human trafficking.
She advances the black pawn on the chessboard.

items.speaker: President
items.text: All very valuable information. How's the Timekeeper doing?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: She's stable. It's worth noting, however, that she brought back a succubus from the Manus.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: She requested that we revoke the arrest warrant for the succubus and grant her all the rights enjoyed by Team Timekeeper in accordance with The Storm Reformation: Manpower and Discipline Act.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I've consented to her request.

items.speaker: President
items.text: Excellent. She's the ideal person to keep watch over the succubus.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Very good, sir.

items.speaker: President
items.text: About Igor ...

items.speaker: President
items.text: The "late Admiral Igor of the Zeno Arms Academy" will be duly honored in the headquarters' Hall of Merit.

items.speaker: President
items.text: His great achievements and remarkable service deserve to be remembered.

items.speaker: President
items.text: That's all for now.
The admiral's betrayal has already cast a lasting shadow over the optimistic '90s.
But the news that, even after losing their leader, the Manus are gathering once again is even more worrying.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Vertin ...
Guest Room, St. Pavlov Foundation

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: London, Lima, Ushuaia ...
The Foundation's reports detail many cases like Duncan's.
One familiar face after another turned into someone else.
The "Storm" has brought everyone with it to the bright and hopeful '90s.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: "A report from Colombia: The mugshots of Pablo Emilio Escobar Gaviria do not match those archived. Similar anomalies have appeared for other notable figures."
There are many such cases.
But the most pressing issue now is Igor's actions.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Why did Igor abduct Ms. Urd?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And why does he want Kimberly?
One question leads to another, but the answers remain a mystery.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And where are Igor and his army going? Why did they defect?
It's a maze of questions and clues.
And there is no waxwing to peer over its walls, and no thread to guide the way out.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Mr. Karson, who was reversed by the "Storm" of 1929, has somehow reappeared in 1990.
If only there were some way to look beyond the towering walls of this maze and see things for what they truly are.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Or maybe there's more to it.
A person pulled under by the river isn't always swallowed. They often wash up on another shore.
Possibilities. More possibilities. Crows gather and drive away the doves, and by the dry, decaying fountain, they peck at the rainwater.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Could it be that ...
She makes a bold guess.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The "Storm" doesn't kill people? At least, not physically?
TO BE CONTINUED…
